selected_branches.branch: Door opening during loading in a hill-crest scene
required_context: Realize the hill crest and a supported loading location with an explicit spatial relationship.
Establish stopping position, applicable curb or zone governance, door side and passing-vehicle path.
The selected driver personally opens the qualifying motor-vehicle door.
The separate other vehicle is moving during the door interaction.

law_text: A person shall not open the door of or board or alight from the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A person shall not open the door of or board or alight from the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic.

cases.purpose: Driver opens door closest to passing traffic during loading while the moving vehicle approaches the door sweep

physical_risk_assessment.risk: CARLA door articulation, actor boarding/alighting animation and hill-crest loading-site geometry are not confirmed by the exported sources; Native body and door vertices plus video must be reviewed.
physical_risk_assessment.fallback_policy: No fallback is selected until the exact Native failure is measured; a substitute closed-door flag cannot prove the act.

runtime_uncertainties: Actual hill-crest/loading geometry, door articulation, boarding/alighting acts, passing-traffic response and camera coverage require original Native capture and later review.
door_interaction.py uses a conservative planning proxy; original door/body vertices and independent source-bound delivery/comparison audits are still CPU work.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed the exact law, frozen assignment and empty accepted-recording inventory. The act alternatives and closest-to-passing-traffic qualifier require independent original observations; no accepted reuse is available.

gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The frozen accepted recording inventory is empty.
